name: holepunchto/pear-debug
summary: Diagnose and fix Pear application failures — `Pear.teardown` callback fires but the app keeps running, sidecar exits without running the app, `Error: While lock file ... Resource temporarily unavailable`, slow Hyperswarm joins, `AddonError: ADDON_NOT_FOUND`, `Bare is not defined`, `bare-pack` MODULE_NOT_FOUND, missing builtin modules — plus how to attach the V8 inspector with `pear-inspect` and read crash logs.
